SELECT
        s.s_suppkey,
        s.s_name,
        s.s_address,
        s.s_phone,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01'
      AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-04-01'
    GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone
    HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) = (
        SELECT MIN(total_revenue)
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_revenue
            FROM supplier s
            JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey

        )
    )
    ORDER BY s.s_suppkey

        ```sql
SELECT 
        ```
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM part p
JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
WHERE p.p_brand NOT LIKE 'Brand#45%'
    AND p.p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
    AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
    AND s.s_comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
    AND s.s_acctbal > 0
GROUP BY p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size
ORDER BY supplier_cnt DESC, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size ASC

1. Filters suppliers in 'SAUDI ARABIA'
2. Counts line items where:
   - Order status is 'F'
   - Line item was received after its commit date
   - Order has at least one line item from a different supplier
   - At least one line item from a different supplier on that order was also received after its commit date
3. Report supplier name and count
4. Sort by count descending, then supplier name
5. Return top 100 rows

- orders has o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderstatus, o_totalprice, o_orderdate, o_orderpriority, o_clerk, o_shippriority, o_comment
- lineitem has l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment

```sql
SELECT 
```
  l_returnflag,
  l_linestatus,
  SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty,
  SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price,
  SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sum_disc_price,
  SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) AS sum_charge,
  AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty,
  AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price,
  AVG(l_discount) AS avg_disc,
  COUNT(*) AS count_order
FROM lineitem
WHERE l_shipdate <= '1998-09-02'
GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus

FROM lineitem l
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey

  AND l.l_quantity < 0.2 * (SELECT AVG(l_quantity) FROM lineitem WHERE l_partkey = l.l_partkey)

        *   Calculate sum of `l_extendedprice` for those line items.
        *   Divide by 7.0.
    *   Output Column: `avg_yearly`.
    *   Schema: Standard DuckDB SQL schema (similar to `part` and `lineitem`).

SELECT
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment
FROM
    lineitem l
JOIN
    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN
    nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE
    l.l_shipdate >= '1993-10-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1994-01-01'
    AND l.l_returnflag = 'R'
GROUP BY
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment
ORDER BY
    revenue DESC
LIMIT 20

    ```sql
SELECT
    n.n_name,
    ```
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1.0 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM
    region r
JOIN
    nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN
    lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN
    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE
    r.r_name = 'ASIA'
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name
ORDER BY
    revenue DESC

    p_partkey,
    MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost

  GROUP BY p_partkey
)

  n.n_name,
  p.p_partkey,
  p.p_mfgr,
  s.s_address,
  s.s_phone,
  s.s_comment

JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey

JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey

SELECT
        l.l_shipmode,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS high_line_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS low_line_count
    FROM
        lineitem l
        JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    WHERE
        l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
        AND l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
        AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
        AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate
    GROUP BY
        l.l_shipmode
    ORDER BY
        l.l_shipmode

    ```sql
SELECT
    ```
                c_count,
                custdist
            FROM
                (
                    SELECT
                        c.c_custkey AS custdist,
                        COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS c_count
                    FROM
                        customer c
                    JOIN
                        orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
                    WHERE
                        o.o_comment NOT LIKE '%special%requests%'
                    GROUP BY
                        c.c_custkey

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_suppkey,
        s.s_name,
        s.s_address,
        s.s_phone,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
    FROM
        supplier s
    JOIN
        lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    WHERE
        l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-04-01'
    GROUP BY
        s.s_suppkey,
        s.s_name,
        s.s_address,
        s.s_phone
)
SELECT
    s_suppkey,
    s_name,
    s_address,
    s_phone,
    total_revenue
FROM
    supplier_revenue
WHERE
    total_revenue = (SELECT MIN(total_revenue) FROM supplier_revenue)
ORDER BY
    s_suppkey

SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem
JOIN part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey
WHERE part.p_brand = 'Brand#23'
  AND l_quantity < 0.2 * (SELECT AVG(l_quantity) FROM lineitem WHERE l_partkey = l_partkey)

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem l
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR')
AND l.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
AND (
    p.p_brand IN ('Brand#12', 'Brand#23', 'Brand#34')
    AND (
        p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')
        AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5
    )
    OR
    p.p_brand IN ('Brand#23', 'Brand#34')
    AND (
        p.p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')
        AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10
    )
    OR
    p.p_brand IN ('Brand#34')
    AND (
        p.p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')
        AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15
    )
)

SELECT s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment
FROM partsupp ps
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey

The user wants me to calculate the national market share for orders in a specific time range and region, for parts of a specific type.

Let me break down the requirements:
1. Orders placed between 1995-01-01 and 1996-12-31 inclusive
2. Customers in the 'AMERICA' region
3. Parts of type 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'
4. For each order year, calculate:
   - Fraction of revenue from customers from 'BRAZIL'
   - Total revenue for those line items (suppliers from any nation)
5. Sort by year
6. Output columns: o_year, mkt_share

Let me trace through the schema:
- orders table has o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_custkey
- customer table has c_custkey, c_nationkey
- nation table has n_nationkey, n_name
- region table has r_regionkey, r_name
- lineitem table has l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_extendedprice, l_discount
- part table has p_partkey, p_type

To get the country information:
- From orders -> customer -> nation
- From customer -> nation (to get the nation name)
- From nation -> region (to get the region name)
- From part -> lineitem (to get the part type)
- From lineitem -> supplier (to get the supplier nation)

The calculation:
1. Filter orders by date range (1995-01-01 to 1996-12-31)
2. Filter customers by region 'AMERICA'
3. Filter parts by type 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'
4. For each order year, calculate:
   - Total revenue = SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) for all line items in that year
   - Brazil revenue = SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) where the customer's nation is 'BRAZIL'
   - mkt_share = Brazil revenue / Total revenue

Let me write the query:

```sql
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS o_year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c_nationkey = (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = 'BRAZIL') 
    THEN l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) 
    ELSE 0 END) /
```

    s_address,

JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey

        ```sql
SELECT 
        ```
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS o_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c_nationkey IN (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = 'BRAZIL') 
              THEN l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) 
              ELSE 0 END) AS mkt_share
FROM orders o
JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey

SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
        FROM lineitem l
        JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
        WHERE
            l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR')
            AND l.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
            AND (
                (p.p_brand = 'Brand#12' AND p.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG')
                AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 11
                AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
                OR
                (p.p_brand = 'Brand#23' AND p.p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK')
                AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 10 AND 20
                AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
                OR
                (p.p_brand = 'Brand#34' AND p.p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')
                AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 20 AND 30
                AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15)
            )

1.  **Analyze the Request:**
    *   Goal: Compute total revenue (extended price * (1 - discount)) for specific line items.
    *   Conditions:
        *   Ship mode: 'AIR' OR 'REG AIR'
        *   Ship instruction: 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
        *   Part Brand: 'Brand#12', 'Brand#23', or 'Brand#34'
        *   Part Container: Specific combinations based on brand.
        *   Part Quantity: Specific ranges based on brand.
        *   Part Size: Specific ranges based on brand.
    *   Output Column: `revenue`
    *   Database: DuckDB (SQL dialect).

    *   `part`: Contains `p_brand`, `p_container`, `p_size`, `p_partkey`.

3.  **Construct the Query Logic:**
    *   Join `lineitem` and `part` on `l_partkey = p_partkey`.
    *   Filter `lineitem` for `l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR')` AND `l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'`.
    *   Filter `part` for the specific brand/container combinations.
    *   Calculate revenue: `SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount))`.
    *   Aggregate: `SUM` over the filtered rows.

SELECT 
    s.s_name,
    s.s_address
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'CANADA'
  AND p.p_name LIKE '%forest%'
  AND l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
  AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
  AND ps.ps_availqty > 0.5 * (
      SELECT SUM(l2.l_quantity)
      FROM lineitem l2
      WHERE l2.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
      AND l2.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
      AND l2.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
      AND l2.l_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
  )
GROUP BY s.s_name, s.s_address
ORDER BY s.s_name

WITH part_costs AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.ps_partkey,
        ps.ps_suppkey,
        ps.ps_supplycost,
        p.p_partkey,
        p.p_mfgr,
        p.p_size,
        p.p_type,
        s.s_acctbal,
        s.s_name,
        s.s_address,
        s.s_phone,
        s.s_comment,
        n.n_name,
        r.r_name,
        p.p_partkey,
        p.p_size,
        p.p_type,
        p.p_mfgr,
        s.s_acctbal,
        s.s_name,
        s.s_address,
        s.s_phone,
        s.s_comment,
        n.n_name,
        r.r_name
    FROM part p
    JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
    JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    WHERE p.p_size = 15
        AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
        AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
)
SELECT 
    s_acctbal,
    s_name,
    n_name,
    p_partkey,
    p_mfgr,
    s_address,

```sql
SELECT 
```
    n2.n_name AS supp_nation,
    n3.n_name AS cust_nation,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS l_year,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n3 ON c.c_nationkey = n3.n_nationkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n1 ON s.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
WHERE n2.n_name = 'FRANCE'
    OR n3.n_name = 'GERMANY'
    AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1996-12-31'
GROUP BY n2.n_name, n3.n_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
ORDER BY n2.n_name, n3.n_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)

```sql
SELECT
```
    s.s_name,
    s.s_address
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey AND ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'CANADA'
  AND p.p_name LIKE '%forest%'
  AND l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
  AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
  AND ps.ps_availqty > 0.5 * (SELECT SUM(l_quantity) FROM lineitem WHERE l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey AND l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01')
ORDER BY s.s_name
